source_text: Rabbi Naftali Brawer describes a non-circumcision brit as "newfangled" and "a synthetic ceremony highlighting the absence of brit," arguing it substitutes ritual symbolism for the mandated physical compliance essential to Jewish identity and continuity. [29]
